title: Crate-level docs and lint attributes
description:
`crates/apricity-data/src/lib.rs:1-2` uses `///` where `//!` is meant, so the crate description attaches to `pub mod domain` and the crate has no crate-level docs. No crate sets `#![deny(missing_docs)]` or `#![warn(clippy::…)]`. Doc density is uneven (apricity-sources: 22 doc comments for 23 public items).

Done when: every crate has `//!` docs, `cargo doc --no-deps` runs warning-free in CI, and `#![warn(missing_docs)]` is on for the library crates.
